title: STEADY PAD TRIGGERS
why: J9: trigger travel near 0.35 releases and presses again, firing a semi-auto twice during one pull.
now: RT and LT press above 0.35 and release below 0.25, holding steady between those points.

edits.anchor: var rtOn=!G.over&&!G.paused&&!G.mapOpen&&!G.bagOpen&&trig(7)>0.35;   // v16.72, his order: RT fires or uses the selected item, as a mouse click does

edits.replacement: PAD.adsAim=!!(PAD.ltHeld&&!G.over&&!G.paused); // v28.xx (cw-cx-triggerhyst): focus uses the same hysteresis as fire.
